name: observational-memory
description: Compaction as observational memory: in the background, after each turn and during a long one, an Observer (GPT-5.6 Luna through pi) turns each ~10k-token chunk of the conversation (up to four at once) into attributed, prioritized observations, each with the transcript time range it came from, keeping tool errors and the head and tail of long results; a reply that is incomplete or malformed is never stored, and a Reflector condenses the observations when they grow, to a size it is checked against. Compaction cuts at the observed watermark with no model call and fits one total budget for the model's window: it keeps recent messages whole, the user's messages verbatim, the user's constraints in force (a reversal replaces what it names, a repeat is one line, and constraints over their cap fall back to the built-in compaction rather than drop any), one continuation record of what is active, completed, blocked or waiting for the user, and the instructions given to /compact; a decision waiting for the user stays a question. Skills in use are carried across compactions, and an om_recall tool searches, reads and outlines the full transcript, following a session across moved transcript files, skipping replayed and injected text, and saying what it covered and did not; om_stats and /om-stats report usage per session, and sessions untouched for 30 days are pruned from the store, checked again just before each deletion.
